body: Round 1 (b24d3136..c929569b), Verdict: incorrect; P2 high: program() advanced its line on decoded newlines, so a $'...\n...' jq program put R3 on a later line (an IndexError past the last line, or a hit accepted by an unrelated statement's marker), and an unquoted word continued by backslash-newline (one Lit whose Value drops it) counted short. Fixed in d74204e6: chars() decodes each literal part from its source (a Lit's source keeps the backslash-newlines its Value drops; a $'\n' adds no line; a split backslash-newline's trailing backslash is dropped). Fixtures an.sh, uc.sh (red at e520a7fe) in test_jq_hit_lines_follow_the_source_through_escapes_and_continuations; mutants R1a, R1b, R1c killed (validation section 5).

Round 1, P3 high: the innermost statement dropped continued-statement marker coverage ([[ ]] \ then && ... # marker; case ... \ then in ... # marker) and narrowed normaliser scope (cd -P ... && [[ ]], x=$(realpath ...) && [[ ]], re=$(escape_regex ...); grep -E). Fixed in d74204e6: a statement's lines are its whole &&, || or | chain's (stmts()), a normaliser counts in the code (comments blanked) of those physical lines, and a case statement runs to its `in`. Fixtures ch.sh to ch5.sh in test_a_chained_or_continued_statement_is_one_statement_for_markers_and_normalisers; mutants R2a, R2b, R2c, M19 killed.
Round 1, P3 high: static() dropped ExtGlob parts, so [[ $x == @(/a|/b) ]] lost its R1. Fixed in d74204e6: an extglob's pattern is literal text. Fixture eg.sh; mutant R3 killed.

Round 1, P3 medium: JSON that is not a shfmt AST ({}, null, []) gave zero hits. Fixed in d74204e6: anything but a dict whose Type is File refuses with `shfmt gave no JSON AST`; the parse-failure test answers not-json, {}, null and a Word node; the fake mise answers a File node. Mutants M12, M12b killed. Residual: PATH's shfmt version is printed (the job-log probe), not enforced, as amendment 1 specifies PATH first.

Round 1, P3 high: nodes() recursed, so about 250 chained commands raised RecursionError. Fixed in d74204e6: nodes() and stmts() walk iteratively, and a RecursionError from json.loads refuses as no JSON AST. Fixture lc.sh (300 chained commands); mutant R5 (the recursive walk) killed.

Round 1, P3 medium (design question): the Hdoc skip only drops statements and comments inside $(...) in unquoted heredoc bodies, which bash executes; hq.sh's reasoned marker hid a data-as-code reader. Decision: the task's Design text says heredoc bodies are excluded from shell-rule and marker scanning, so the exclusion stays (a limit recorded in report.md); hq.sh and hu.sh now carry no reasoned marker, and hu.sh adds a comment inside a heredoc substitution, so mutants M5 (statements) and M5b (comments) are killed.

Round 1, P3 high: two mutants survived the module: no double-quote unescaping, and the mise form before PATH's shfmt. Fixed in d74204e6: fixture dq.sh (a jq string holding an escaped backslash) and a PATH-first phase in the fallback test; mutants R1d and M14b killed.

Round 1, P3 low: [[ ${#path} == 0 ]] was a new false positive. Fixed in d74204e6: a ParamExp with Length is no path-named variable, as on b24d3136. Fixture ln.sh; mutant R8 killed. An empty '' (shfmt omits its Value) found by the tree test while fixing is fixture e0.sh, mutant R4.

Round 1, the reviewer judged sound the one deviation from amendment 1's literal text: a lone {{ include }} / {{ template }} line is the no-op `:` rather than spaces, since two tracked templates wrap only includes in a subshell. includeTemplate was added to the lone-action form (fixture t.sh.tmpl, mutant M16b). Limits recorded: a piped `| include` and a lone include in a case-item position. The deviation is for the orchestrator to accept or amend (report.md).
